list_connections.description: List internal connections (rows of name lines) on the developer portal. Throws 'not signed in to app.notion.com' when signed out.

returns.description: [{name, details[]}] per row, header excluded; ids come from open_connection

open_connection.description: Open a connection by exact name.

create_connection.description: Create an API-token internal connection and land on its page. Does NOT reveal the token.

set_capabilities.description: Set capability toggles and user-info level on the open connection (autosaves). Omitted keys unchanged.

share_pages.description: Grant the open connection access to pages by search query, then Save.

exact.description: menuitem text must end with the query

reveal_token.description: Reveal, read and re-hide the API token. Returns the raw secret: capture it into a variable, never print it.

list_spaces.description: List every Notion workspace the signed-in user belongs to, via the internal API from an app.notion.com tab. Throws 'not signed in to app.notion.com' when signed out.

get_records.description: Fetch records by id with syncRecordValuesSpace (internal API, any workspace).

returns.description: map id -> record value (double value unwrapped); null when missing

query_collection.description: Query a database view with queryCollection (internal API, any workspace).

save_transaction.description: Write blocks with saveTransactionsFanout (internal API, any workspace). Refuses a top-level page set (parent_table space) that lacks a non-empty permissions array, because that page becomes an uneditable role-none orphan.

operations.description: [{pointer:{table,id}, path, command: set|update|listAfter|listBefore|listRemove|setPermissionItem, args}]; spaceId is filled into each pointer

read_collection.description: Read a database page through the internal API: schema names and every row as property name -> plain value. Dates give start ("start -> end"), people "@<userId>", relations "rel:<pageId>". Each row carries _id for recreateRows. Read-only.

spaceId.description: workspace id; readCollection and recreateRows find it from pageId when omitted

create_page.description: WRITE. Create a top-level page with blocks in one saveTransactionsFanout. Requires a non-empty editors array: its user_permission editor rows go on the page, otherwise it becomes an uneditable role-none orphan.

parentAfter.description: id of the top-level page to sit after; omit to append

blocks.description: [[type, richText|string]] or ["table", [[cell,...],...]] (first row is the header)

editors.description: user ids that get role editor

recreate_rows.description: WRITE. Update database row properties by replacing rows: in-place updates are rejected ("Block property value updates must use high-level property operations"), so each row is recreated with merged properties and the old row is set alive:false. dryRun:true builds the ops and sends nothing.

spaceId.description: workspace id; readCollection and recreateRows find it from pageId when omitted

changes.description: [{rowId, set:{PropertyName: string|raw rich-text array}}]; rowId from readCollection _id

page_property_history.description: Read-only. Who changed which property of a page or database row, and when, from the internal activity log (getActivityLog). Use it when the public API last_edited_by is overwritten by an automation actor. Property keys resolve to names through the parent collection schema.

pageId.description: page or row block id, dashed or undashed uuid

returns.description: [{time (ISO), type, authors[name|raw id], changes[{prop,before,after}]}] newest first; before/after null when the property was absent; bot authors (integrations, automations) are not in notion_user and stay raw ids
